uploads.name: Arnavaz
uploads.description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask carved with gold floral tracery and a dark streak down the right cheek, long straight black hair with blunt fringe, long cream tassel earrings. Slate-blue wool vest embroidered with gold flowers, silver belt, full cream linen blouse and wide gathered trousers, silver cuffs and embossed silver boots.

uploads.name: Shahrnaz
uploads.description: Daughter of Jamshid. Ivory mask covered in fine gold floral tracery, long straight centre-parted black hair, disc-and-tassel earrings. Quilted cream bib embroidered with dark red rosettes, black puffed sleeves, long layered charcoal tweed skirt, bronze arm cuffs, medallion belt, black boots.

uploads.name: Musician
uploads.description: Court musician. Tall black velvet hat worn low over the eyes, embroidered with a silver cross motif, long black hair, drop earrings. Long dark brown linen robe with embroidered collar and cuffs, tasselled woven sash, embroidered slippers. Plays a pear-shaped lute, standing or seated on a carved stool.

uploads.name: Cat Persian Longhair
uploads.description: Long-haired Persian cat, ginger and cream with a white ruff, chest and paws, heavy plumed tail, half-lidded amber eyes. Photographed lying on a carpet-covered bench against a pale plaster wall.

uploads.name: Instrument Saz
uploads.description: Long-necked pear-shaped lute, about 120 cm. Pale spruce soundboard, ribbed dark rosewood back with light inlay lines, tied gut frets, carved animal-head pegbox with four dark wooden pegs, four strings, tied bridge, black wooden stand. Also seen in the daughters chamber (LOC-020).

uploads.name: Dagger Horse Head
uploads.description: Ornate straight dagger, about 28 cm. Bronze horse-head pommel with red gem eyes, black cord-wrapped grip between jewelled bronze collars, gem-set crossguard, tapering double-edged blade with pierced bronze filigree and inset red stones down the centre. Worn at the sash with a dark red embroidered robe.
